newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma, bonds idle, fx forwards ease.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma, bonds idle, fx forwards ease.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was fluctuating narrowly around 309.85, the day's fixing, in late quiet dealings, bonds were little changed and depos and forex forwards were softer, dealers said.
"Ecu/drachma is hovering around 309.85," said a forex dealer at a private bank. "It is very quiet."
Mark/drachma firmed, trading around 157 on a stronger mark vis-a-vis the dollar, dealers said.

Asked if local corporations borrowing in foreign currencies had opted to close out positions following Wednesday's forex outflows estimated at more than 700 million ecus, some dealers said activity was just heavier than usual.
Bonds were holding morning levels awaiting developments in the money market where depos and forex forwards eased a fifth of a point or more with the drop more accentuated in short tenors.
"Depos and forex forwards have eased about a fifth of a point in long tenors and even more in short tenors," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "The rate outlook is brighter today."
Liquidity is driving short-term yields and the market is cash strapped right now, he said.
"It will be interesting to see what the central bank will do on Friday to relieve the expected liquidity squeeze," the dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 156.95/00 from Thursday's 157.095 fix, the dollar at 282.42/52 drachmas from 282.140 and the ecu at 309.84/94 from 309.85 drachmas.
